subject: A question About Your Video Sonic...
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
Do you have the rights to create a movie about the Burnout Franchise?

Im just kind of wondering because afterall, if your going to start selling a video about Burnout and the License and Rights of the series are owned by Criterion, doesnt that make it so that they get some amount of money from you selling a movie about their game and product? I just didnt want you to fall into a Pitfall about this and maybe getting sued later for creating a movie about their franchise without them getting any money for it... you know?
